title: CORE-7120 follow-up: package-page "Please note:" footnote headings are #363636, live is #313131
body:
**Pre-existing defect, surfaced by T5's (CORE-7120) gate-lane regression sweep — NOT caused by it.** ## Problem On three package pages the "Please note:" footnote is marked up as `

Please note:

` and renders `#363636` on the clone, where live renders `#313131`. | Page | Live | Clone (origin/main) | |---|---|---| | `/package/all-inclusive-package/` | `rgb(49,49,49)` | `rgb(54,54,54)` | | `/package/privacy-package/` | `rgb(49,49,49)` | `rgb(54,54,54)` | | `/package/basic-package/` | `rgb(49,49,49)` | `rgb(54,54,54)` | ## Why it is its own task Live does NOT use one global rule for "bold inside a heading" — it resolves per component by CSS specificity. `/cookies-policy/` headings sit in a page-generic wrapper and resolve to `#595959`; these package footnotes sit in a page-specific footnote wrapper and resolve to `#313131`. On the clone BOTH render through the same block, same RichText component, same CSS class — **nothing distinguishes them**, so a single shared selector cannot express both. T5 was therefore scoped to `/cookies-policy/` only; fixing these three needs a distinguishing class/selector (or a scoped component change), which is a schema/markup change beyond CORE-7120. ## Likely approach Introduce a distinguishing class for the footnote-styled-as-heading pattern (or scope the package block's own styles), so cookies-policy keeps `#595959` while these footnotes take `#313131`. ⛔ Do NOT solve it by widening the shared `.payload-richtext:not(.prose) :is(h1..h6) strong, b` rule — that is exactly what regressed these pages. ## Evidence Gate-lane report: `lane-reports/T5-2.md` (measured Source/Before/After per page at 1024). **ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA** - The "Please note:" footnote heading renders `rgb(49,49,49)` on all three package pages, matching live, at 360/768/1024/1800. - `/cookies-policy/` headings still render `rgb(89,89,89)` — no regression to T5's shipped fix. - Body bold elsewhere still renders `rgb(49,49,49)` (T4/CORE-7119) and heading elements' own colour is unchanged. - A regression sweep over every page whose richtext contains bold-in-heading confirms no other page moved further from live.
acceptanceCriteria: The "Please note:" footnote heading bold run renders `rgb(49,49,49)` on /all-inclusive-package/, /privacy-package/ and /basic-package/, matching live.
⛔ /cookies-policy/ headings are UNCHANGED at `rgb(89,89,89)` — T5 (PR #95, merged) set those deliberately and must not regress.
Body-copy bold outside headings is unchanged at `rgb(49,49,49)` (T4, merged) — verify on /id-requirements/.
No change to font-size, font-weight, spacing or layout on any affected page.
